definitions.gloss: fearfulness; terror; dreadfulness; how frightening (something) is
definitions.explanation: The quality or degree of being frightening. Formed by attaching the noun-forming suffix さ to the i-adjective {恐|おそ}ろしい (frightening, terrible).

examples.japanese: {戦争|せんそう}の{恐|おそ}ろしさを{知|し}る。
{無知|むち}の{恐|おそ}ろしさに{気付|きづ}いた。
examples.english: I realized how frightening ignorance is.

examples.japanese: {自然災害|しぜんさいがい}の{恐|おそ}ろしさを{改|あらた}めて{感|かん}じた。
examples.english: I felt anew the terror of natural disasters.

notes:
Noun form of {恐|おそ}ろしい (frightening). The suffix さ converts an adjective into a noun denoting the quality or degree.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜の{恐|おそ}ろしさを{知|し}る: come to know the terror of 
- {恐|おそ}ろしさに{震|ふる}える: tremble with fear
- {恐|おそ}ろしさを{感|かん}じる: feel terror
- {恐|おそ}ろしさを{伝|つた}える: convey how frightening (something) is

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {恐怖|きょうふ}: fear, dread — the emotion itself, as felt by a person
- {怖|こわ}さ: scariness — more colloquial; everyday register
- {恐|おそ}ろしさ: dreadfulness — the quality of being terrible, often spoken of objectively
